create_env_renderer: create an EnvRenderer instance with a custom environment, title, camera, and window size
render_ground: render the ground plane using either default texture or bullet native renderer with configurable options
update_cam: update the camera origin, position, distance, or translate based on get_cam_parameters return values
keyboard_callback: handle keyboard input to toggle render flags or save and load camera state via pickle
axis_to_str: convert a 3D axis vector to its corresponding x, y, or z string label
